body.description: Benny, a young man in his twenties who hauls water for the church: curly hair under a green cap, a white undershirt, a rope sling with two plastic water jugs across his back, rolled jeans, sandals, earnest face. a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
